description: This Java class 'DriverFactory' manages the creation, retrieval, and cleanup of Selenium WebDriver instances for browser automation tests. It supports Chrome and Firefox, handles parallel execution via ThreadLocal storage, includes retry logic for resilience, and configures browser options suitable for CI environments.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing factory methods to initialize, retrieve, and quit WebDriver instances for parallel browser automation testing.

methods.name: initDriver
methods.description: Initializes a WebDriver based on configured browser type and capabilities, employing retries and custom options, then stores it in ThreadLocal.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the WebDriver instance for the current thread.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits and cleans up the WebDriver instance for the current thread.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Dispatches creation to specific browser driver methods based on browser type.

methods.name: createChromeDriver
methods.description: Configures and creates a Chrome WebDriver with flags suitable for CI/testing.

methods.name: createFirefoxDriver
methods.description: Configures and creates a Firefox WebDriver with headless options if specified.

methods.name: parseIntSafe
methods.description: Safely parses a string into an integer, defaulting to 2 if parsing fails.
